b'proposed\t01_CONSTITUTION/SOFTWARE_FACTORY_PLAYBOOK.md\t431\tpersist\tRETAIN\tServer-side durable outcome/idempotency or evidence requirement; not raw contact browser storage.\t**Executable error-handling example withdrawn.** Return a generic client error. Log only an allow-listed structured record: correlation ID, operation, normalized failure class and safe provider code. Exclude raw exceptions, request bodies, credentials, payment details and personal data. A negative test plants synthetic sensitive markers and asserts that neither client output nor retained logs contain them. The Architect includes the API trust-boundary matrix in the acceptance contract; the Engineer supplies engineering results, the QA Executor derives independent checks, and the QA Lead approves and grades them. Cover unauthenticated/wrong-role/wrong-owner calls, forged payment status, tampered totals, duplicate and concurrent requests, invalid signatures, pre-acceptance persistence failure, post-acceptance worker failure, and stale/out-of-order events. Each case records status, absence of unauthorized effects, persisted final state and retry/recovery evidence. TESTING_PLAYBOOK owns the matrix; commerce, subscription and API manuals refer to it. Declare wire and internal types separately and normalize once at the service boundary. A named operation uses one parameter signature and typed result envelope in its service, route and client examples. Any independent alternative is explicitly labeled with its own contract; callers do not silently mix array, paginated and wrapped results. Implement only against a verified project service contract; distinguish empty success from failure and redact internal/upstream detail from public responses and logs.\r\n'
